summary: The MVP matching engine is structurally implemented and fixture-tested, but it cannot be approved for private beta because the production College Football 27 catalog is empty and there are zero real completed feasibility-study participants or result rows.

evidence: data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports validParticipants = 0 and topOneAcceptanceRate.denominator = 0.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md requires at least 55% of testers to rate the top result 4 or 5.
data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports topThreeUsefulnessRate.denominator = 0.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md requires at least 75% of testers to rate at least one top-three result 4 or 5.
data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports repeatability.repeatScanParticipants = 0.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md says repeatability is synthetic only.
criteria.releaseImpact: Cannot validate repeatability for private-beta matching.

evidence: data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports confidenceCalibration.status = not_calculable.
data/phase-zero/matching_weight_optimization_decision.json reports no real data exists to measure improvement or regression.
criteria.releaseImpact: Cannot calibrate or validate confidence labels.

evidence: docs/MATCHING_ENGINE_SPEC.md requires the matcher to return no matches unless an approved verified production catalog exists.
web/tests/matching-engine.test.ts covers empty catalog, unapproved catalog, fixture leakage, and production gate behavior.
data/catalog/production/catalog_manifest.json contains 0 items, and production recommendations remain fail-closed.
criteria.releaseImpact: Failure behavior is correct, but it does not unblock release.

evidence: docs/MATCHING_ENGINE_SPEC.md requires relative game-option match-score language and prohibits identity-probability language.
web/tests/matching-engine.test.ts covers explanation wording, reasons, differences, ties, uncertainty, and catalog traceability with test fixtures.
No real production recommendations exist to validate explanation accuracy against verified College Football 27 records.
criteria.releaseImpact: Needs real catalog and study validation before private-beta approval.

evidence: data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports no hair recommendation rating and no facial-hair recommendation rating.
docs/phase-zero/APPEARANCE_MENU_GAP_MATRIX.md marks Hairstyles, Hair colors, Facial hair, and Facial-hair colors as suspected/not observed or incomplete and blocked.
data/catalog/production/catalog_manifest.json contains 0 verified records.
criteria.releaseImpact: Cannot evaluate hair or facial-hair usefulness.

evidence: web/tests/refinement.test.ts covers screenshot intake, validation, deletion, unavailable behavior, and fixture-only refinement cases.
web/tests/refinement.test.ts keeps production refinement unavailable when the approved production catalog is empty.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md says real verified result saving and recommendations cannot be exercised while the catalog is empty.
criteria.releaseImpact: Not releasable for real recommendation refinement.

evidence: data/phase-zero/manual_matching_accuracy_analysis.json reports rawParticipantMediaCommitted = false and rawParticipantMediaAnalyzed = false.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md marks data deletion ready with manual device verification and privacy wording ready with legal review pending.
AGENTS.md requires raw face media deleted by default and prohibits identity or sensitive-trait inference.
criteria.releaseImpact: Privacy scaffolding is not the primary blocker, but legal/manual QA is still required before real beta collection.

evidence: data/catalog/production/catalog_manifest.json contains 0 items and version empty-production.
data/catalog/production-releases/cf27-production-empty-2026-07-14/production_readiness_decision.json decision is BLOCKED_NO_PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE_RECORDS.
data/phase-zero/manual_matching_study_readiness_decision.json reports verifiedProductionCatalog = BLOCKED.
criteria.releaseImpact: This is the primary release blocker.

exactEvidence: data/phase-zero/matching_weight_optimization_decision.json: no candidate matcher adopted and baseline remains active because no real completed study data exists.
docs/PRIVATE_BETA_READINESS.md: not ready for a real private beta that evaluates College Football 27 recommendations.
web/tests/matching-engine.test.ts: fixture and production-gate tests pass, but real production matching remains blocked.
decisionRationale: Release criteria requiring measured top-one acceptance, top-three usefulness, repeatability, confidence calibration, and hair/facial-hair usefulness have no real participant denominator.
The production catalog contains no verified College Football 27 records, so the matcher cannot produce release-eligible recommendations.
Fail-closed behavior is correct and should be preserved.
Approving with limitations would be misleading because the central matching result cannot be shown or evaluated.
requiredToReconsider: Approve a nonempty verified production College Football 27 catalog release.
Run the approved 10-20 participant feasibility study with consent, paired reviewer rows, participant ratings, and deletion confirmations.
Recalculate top-one acceptance, top-three usefulness, repeatability, confidence calibration, hair/facial-hair usefulness, and screenshot-refinement outcomes from real completed data.
Rerun matching-engine release review after the new evidence is committed.
